anna_sales: Heads-up  Acme hit truncation during the demo. They sent a giant chat history plus an attached JSON blob and the model returned a truncated completion + a 400 error.
acme_poc_dev: Repro steps: our client builds messages array (~120k characters) + attachment metadata in `input_context`. We POST to /v1/chat with application/json. Request id: req-9f4c. On the wire size ~12MB. Response: 400 {"error":"request too large"} and the completion stream cut mid-sentence.
devin_se: likely hitting a service parser limit or gateway cap. Can you paste the top of the raw request (headers + size)?
acme_poc_dev: Headers: `Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8` (no Content-Encoding). Our client reports Content-Length: 12500000.
leo_sre: our logs: ingress saw `bytes`=12546378, gateway returned 413 at the edge, but our ingest service also has `max_payload_bytes`=10,485,760 (10MB). So two limits: edge 8MB and service 10MB. This one crossed both, gateway dropped it first.
rachel_devex: quick suggestions to share with Acme: 1) trim chat history server-side (keep last N turns), 2) offload attachments to presigned storage and send URLs, 3) use token-aware chunking (split by tokens not chars). Example python to chunk by tokens: ```from tiktoken import encoding_for_model
enc = encoding_for_model('redwood-4k')
def chunk(text, max_toks=3000): ids = enc.encode(text); for i in range(0, len(ids), max_toks): yield enc.decode(ids[i:i+max_toks])```
devin_se: short-term options for the POC: A) temporary gateway bump to 16MB for acct-acme-poc, B) have them gzip payload with Content-Encoding: gzip (we support it), C) instruct them to switch to streaming API (longer term).
acme_poc_dev: gzip would be quick for us. Do you accept gzip on the demo route? Our client libs support it.
leo_sre: yes we accept gzip. If they can gzip and set `Content-Encoding: gzip` that should drop the body under 8MB and avoid changes. If not, we can apply a 16MB route override for 24h.
gateway-bot: API Gateway change queued: route `acct-acme-poc` max_body_bytes -> 16777216. change_id=chg-6011
rachel_devex: added a snippet for our SDK that auto-detects large payloads and compresses: ```const body = JSON.stringify(payload); const compressed = await gzipCompress(body); fetch(url, { method:'POST', body:compressed, headers:{'Content-Encoding':'gzip','Content-Type':'application/json'} })```
anna_sales: (typo) anna_sales: locking plan: Rachel send gzip+chunk guide, Devin confirm streaming fallback, Leo apply bump if gzip fails. Acme, please retest after trying gzip and report back.
acme_poc_dev: will try gzip first and post results here. thanks!
